P1.did_zh: 研究对 610 人的静息态 fMRI 进行动态连接分析，比较精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症与健康对照。在最常出现的连接状态中，三类患者的视觉、感觉运动、显著性及额顶网络内部连接均较低。
P1.did_en: Dynamic resting-state connectivity was examined in 610 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. In the most frequent connectivity state, all three patient groups showed lower within-network connectivity in visual, sensorimotor, salience and frontoparietal networks.
P1.relation_zh: 该研究提供了显著性网络跨诊断低连接的线索。本案例把动态网络层面的观察具体化为右侧 ROI312 到该网络的静态平均连接，并检验双相与精神分裂症谱系是否同向。
P1.relation_en: The salience-network finding motivates a shared diagnostic pattern. This case turns a dynamic network-level observation into a specific static mean-connection test from right ROI312 in bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.

P2.did_zh: 这篇综述汇总多个精神疾病中左右脑同源区域的静息态连接研究。多种疾病在注意、显著性、感觉运动等网络出现同源连接降低，但 ADHD 的模式不同。
P2.did_en: This review compared resting-state connectivity between matching regions in the two hemispheres across psychiatric disorders. Several disorders showed reduced homotopic connectivity in attention, salience and sensorimotor networks, whereas ADHD showed a different pattern.
P2.relation_zh: 综述提示，连接降低可能跨越传统诊断分类。本案例进一步询问，这一共同方向能否出现在具体分区到显著性网络的连接中，而不仅是左右脑同源区域之间。
P2.relation_en: The review motivates a cross-diagnostic decrease. This case asks whether the shared direction also appears between a specific parcel and the salience network, rather than only between matching regions across hemispheres.

P3.did_zh: 研究比较 512 名精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症患者及健康对照的脑网络。三类患者均出现短距离连接降低，主要涉及感觉及联合皮层；中、长距离连接则升高，其前额叶分布随疾病而异。
P3.did_en: Brain networks were compared in 512 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. Short-range connectivity was reduced across patient groups, particularly in sensory and association cortex. Medium- and long-range connectivity increased, with different prefrontal distributions across disorders.
P3.relation_zh: 共同的短程连接降低为跨诊断假设提供依据；同时存在的长程连接升高说明不能预设所有连接都下降。因此，本案例针对 ROI312 的指定连接单独检验方向。
P3.relation_en: Shared short-range decreases motivate the hypothesis, while long-range increases show that direction depends on the connection. The ROI312 connection therefore requires its own directional test.

P4.did_zh: 研究在 271 名参与者中比较精神分裂症、抑郁症、双相障碍与健康对照的静息态活动和连接。三类患者均有岛叶连接降低，以及部分额叶、扣带区域活动降低，同时也存在各疾病特有的改变。
P4.did_en: Resting-state activity and connectivity were compared across schizophrenia, depression, bipolar disorder and controls in 271 participants. The patient groups shared reduced insular connectivity and lower activity in some frontal and cingulate regions, alongside disorder-specific changes.
P4.relation_zh: 跨诊断岛叶连接结果提供显著性网络的相关背景，但不能直接验证特定右侧 ROI312 到整个网络的平均连接。
P4.relation_en: Cross-diagnostic insular connectivity provides salience-network context, not direct validation of mean connectivity from the specific right ROI312 to the whole network.

P5.did_zh: 研究比较 41 名未用药、处于抑郁发作期的双相 II 型患者与 68 名对照。患者右后岛叶与左中央后回连接降低，并与较高 IL-6 水平相关；另一些前岛叶连接则升高。
P5.did_en: The study compared 41 unmedicated patients with bipolar II depression and 68 controls. Right posterior insula–left postcentral connectivity was lower and related to higher IL-6 levels, while some anterior-insular connections were increased.
P5.relation_zh: 涉及岛叶及感觉运动连接，并同时报告升高和降低；双相 II 型抑郁期样本不等同于本例全部病例或特定 ROI312。
P5.relation_en: It examines insular and sensorimotor connectivity with both increases and decreases. Bipolar II depression is not equivalent to this case's full case groups or specific ROI312.

P1.did_zh: 研究比较 18 名双相 I 型患者与 20 名健康对照的感觉运动网络，并评估执行功能。患者部分网络内连接升高、感觉运动与默认模式网络间连接降低，一些连接差异与躁狂症状及数字广度表现相关。
P1.did_en: Resting-state sensorimotor connectivity and executive function were studied in 18 people with bipolar I disorder and 20 controls. Patients showed increased connectivity in parts of the sensorimotor network but reduced connectivity with the default-mode network. Some differences related to mania symptoms and digit-span performance.
P1.relation_zh: 该研究把感觉运动连接异常与双相障碍的执行功能联系起来，说明值得在该网络中寻找表型。它同时报告升高与降低，本案例因此对左侧 ROI108 的指定连接及跨诊断方向另行检验。
P1.relation_en: The link with executive function motivates examining the sensorimotor network in bipolar disorder. Because the study found both increases and decreases, this case separately tests the specific ROI108 connection and its direction across diagnoses.

P2.did_zh: 研究在 271 名参与者中比较精神分裂症、抑郁症、双相障碍与健康对照的静息态活动和连接。三类患者均有岛叶连接降低，以及部分额叶、扣带区域活动降低，同时也存在各疾病特有的改变。
P2.did_en: Resting-state activity and connectivity were compared across schizophrenia, depression, bipolar disorder and controls in 271 participants. The patient groups shared reduced insular connectivity and lower activity in some frontal and cingulate regions, alongside disorder-specific changes.
P2.relation_zh: 三类疾病共享连接异常，为寻找共同脑表型提供背景。本案例把这一思路落到左侧 ROI108—感觉运动网络连接，集中比较双相与精神分裂症谱系。
P2.relation_en: Shared abnormalities across disorders motivate a common imaging phenotype. This case focuses that idea on left ROI108–sensorimotor connectivity in bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.

P3.did_zh: 研究让 22 名精神分裂症患者和 16 名健康对照完成视觉言语提示任务。患者左后颞下回的任务激活较低，该区域与双侧中央沟盖、颞上回及左岛叶的连接也较弱。
P3.did_en: A visual-speech priming task was studied in 22 people with schizophrenia and 16 controls. Patients showed lower task-related activation of the left posterior inferior temporal gyrus and weaker connectivity from that region to the Rolandic operculum, superior temporal gyri and left insula.
P3.relation_zh: 视觉、言语与感觉运动相关区域之间的低连接，为本案例提供局部回路线索。当前问题则检验静息状态下分区到整个感觉运动网络的平均连接，并增加双相障碍比较。
P3.relation_en: Weaker connections among visual, speech and sensorimotor-related regions provide a circuit-level clue. The current test concerns resting-state mean connectivity to the whole sensorimotor network and adds a bipolar comparison.

P4.did_zh: 研究对 610 人的静息态 fMRI 进行动态连接分析，比较精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症与健康对照。在最常出现的连接状态中，三类患者的视觉、感觉运动、显著性及额顶网络内部连接均较低。
P4.did_en: Dynamic resting-state connectivity was examined in 610 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. In the most frequent connectivity state, all three patient groups showed lower within-network connectivity in visual, sensorimotor, salience and frontoparietal networks.
P4.relation_zh: 动态感觉运动网络的跨诊断结果与本例相关，但动态网络内连接不等于左侧 ROI108 的静态网络平均连接。
P4.relation_en: Cross-diagnostic dynamic sensorimotor-network findings are relevant, but within-network dynamic connectivity is not static mean connectivity from left ROI108.

P5.did_zh: 研究比较 512 名精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症患者及健康对照的脑网络。三类患者均出现短距离连接降低，主要涉及感觉及联合皮层；中、长距离连接则升高，其前额叶分布随疾病而异。
P5.did_en: Brain networks were compared in 512 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. Short-range connectivity was reduced across patient groups, particularly in sensory and association cortex. Medium- and long-range connectivity increased, with different prefrontal distributions across disorders.
P5.relation_zh: 短程降低与长程升高提示连接方向依赖空间尺度；这是左侧 ROI108—感觉运动网络检验的背景，不是该精确端点的验证。
P5.relation_en: Short-range decreases and long-range increases show dependence on spatial scale. This is context for the left ROI108–sensorimotor test, not validation of that exact endpoint.

P1.did_zh: 研究在 271 名参与者中比较精神分裂症、抑郁症、双相障碍与健康对照的静息态活动和连接。三类患者均有岛叶连接降低，以及部分额叶、扣带区域活动降低，同时也存在各疾病特有的改变。
P1.did_en: Resting-state activity and connectivity were compared across schizophrenia, depression, bipolar disorder and controls in 271 participants. The patient groups shared reduced insular connectivity and lower activity in some frontal and cingulate regions, alongside disorder-specific changes.
P1.relation_zh: 岛叶及显著性网络的共同异常，是本案例选择显著性/腹侧注意网络的主要依据。当前实验进一步定位到右侧 ROI254，并检查两类诊断及外部队列是否呈同一方向。
P1.relation_en: Shared insular and salience-network abnormalities motivate selecting the salience/ventral attention network. The present test narrows this to right ROI254 and examines agreement across two diagnoses and external cohorts.

P2.did_zh: 研究让 22 名精神分裂症患者和 16 名健康对照完成视觉言语提示任务。患者左后颞下回的任务激活较低，该区域与双侧中央沟盖、颞上回及左岛叶的连接也较弱。
P2.did_en: A visual-speech priming task was studied in 22 people with schizophrenia and 16 controls. Patients showed lower task-related activation of the left posterior inferior temporal gyrus and weaker connectivity from that region to the Rolandic operculum, superior temporal gyri and left insula.
P2.relation_zh: 该研究提供了精神分裂症中视觉相关区域与岛叶、感觉运动相关区域连接较弱的线索。本案例把局部任务回路问题扩展为静息态的分区—网络比较，并纳入双相障碍。
P2.relation_en: The study provides a clue about weaker visual-related connections to insular and sensorimotor-related regions in schizophrenia. This case extends the circuit question to a resting-state parcel-to-network comparison and includes bipolar disorder.

P3.did_zh: 研究比较 41 名未用药、处于抑郁发作期的双相 II 型患者与 68 名对照。患者右后岛叶与左中央后回连接降低，并与较高 IL-6 水平相关；另一些前岛叶连接则升高。
P3.did_en: The study compared 41 unmedicated patients with bipolar II depression and 68 controls. Right posterior insula–left postcentral connectivity was lower and related to higher IL-6 levels, while some anterior-insular connections were increased.
P3.relation_zh: 岛叶—感觉运动连接降低为双相障碍一侧提供了具体线索，与显著性网络研究形成互补。本案例不测量炎症，而是检验指定 ROI—网络连接能否成为两类诊断共有的影像表现。
P3.relation_en: Reduced insula–sensorimotor connectivity provides a specific bipolar clue that complements the salience-network evidence. This case tests a shared imaging pattern in two diagnoses; it does not measure inflammation.

P4.did_zh: 研究对 610 人的静息态 fMRI 进行动态连接分析，比较精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症与健康对照。在最常出现的连接状态中，三类患者的视觉、感觉运动、显著性及额顶网络内部连接均较低。
P4.did_en: Dynamic resting-state connectivity was examined in 610 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. In the most frequent connectivity state, all three patient groups showed lower within-network connectivity in visual, sensorimotor, salience and frontoparietal networks.
P4.relation_zh: 显著性网络的动态低连接与该主题相关，但不直接验证右侧 ROI254 到网络的静态均值。
P4.relation_en: Dynamic salience-network hypoconnectivity is relevant, but does not directly validate static mean connectivity from right ROI254.

P5.did_zh: 研究比较 512 名精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症患者及健康对照的脑网络。三类患者均出现短距离连接降低，主要涉及感觉及联合皮层；中、长距离连接则升高，其前额叶分布随疾病而异。
P5.did_en: Brain networks were compared in 512 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. Short-range connectivity was reduced across patient groups, particularly in sensory and association cortex. Medium- and long-range connectivity increased, with different prefrontal distributions across disorders.
P5.relation_zh: 提供跨诊断网络异常及空间尺度差异的背景；特定右侧 ROI254 的连接方向仍需本例独立检验。
P5.relation_en: It provides cross-diagnostic network and spatial-scale context; the direction for the specific right ROI254 connection still requires this case's own test.

P1.did_zh: 研究对 610 人的静息态 fMRI 进行动态连接分析，比较精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症与健康对照。在最常出现的连接状态中，三类患者的视觉、感觉运动、显著性及额顶网络内部连接均较低。
P1.did_en: Dynamic resting-state connectivity was examined in 610 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. In the most frequent connectivity state, all three patient groups showed lower within-network connectivity in visual, sensorimotor, salience and frontoparietal networks.
P1.relation_zh: 这项研究直接提供了跨诊断感觉运动网络内部连接降低的线索。本案例沿用同一网络问题，但改用静态平均连接指标，并在多个外部队列中检查双相和精神分裂症谱系的结果方向。
P1.relation_en: This study directly motivates a shared decrease within the sensorimotor network. The current case uses static mean connectivity and checks the bipolar and schizophrenia-spectrum pattern across external cohorts.

P2.did_zh: 研究比较 18 名双相 I 型患者与 20 名健康对照的感觉运动网络，并评估执行功能。患者部分网络内连接升高、感觉运动与默认模式网络间连接降低，一些连接差异与躁狂症状及数字广度表现相关。
P2.did_en: Resting-state sensorimotor connectivity and executive function were studied in 18 people with bipolar I disorder and 20 controls. Patients showed increased connectivity in parts of the sensorimotor network but reduced connectivity with the default-mode network. Some differences related to mania symptoms and digit-span performance.
P2.relation_zh: 直接涉及感觉运动网络，但双相 I 型患者部分网络内连接升高，与一概下降的解释不一致；ICA 局部连接也不等于本例全网络均值。作为相关的方向差异保留，不恢复为原假设支持。
P2.relation_en: It directly concerns the sensorimotor network, but some within-network connections increased in bipolar I disorder, qualifying a uniform-decrease interpretation. Local ICA connectivity is not the whole-network mean. It is retained as a related directional difference, not restored as original support.

P3.did_zh: 研究比较 512 名精神分裂症、双相障碍、抑郁症患者及健康对照的脑网络。三类患者均出现短距离连接降低，主要涉及感觉及联合皮层；中、长距离连接则升高，其前额叶分布随疾病而异。
P3.did_en: Brain networks were compared in 512 people with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression or no psychiatric diagnosis. Short-range connectivity was reduced across patient groups, particularly in sensory and association cortex. Medium- and long-range connectivity increased, with different prefrontal distributions across disorders.
P3.relation_zh: 作为跨诊断网络空间尺度的背景重新核查：短程和长程方向不同，并未直接检验本例 SomMot 网络内均值，不据此恢复历史支持信用。
P3.relation_en: Reassessed as cross-diagnostic spatial-scale context: short- and long-range directions differ, and the study did not test this case's within-SomMot mean. No historical support credit is restored.

P4.did_zh: 静息态 fMRI 比较精神分裂症、双相障碍与对照，发现精神分裂症的丘脑内部及丘脑—额顶连接降低，而双相障碍的丘脑—躯体运动连接升高。
P4.did_en: Resting-state fMRI compared schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and controls. Within-thalamic and thalamo-frontoparietal connectivity was reduced in schizophrenia, whereas thalamo-somatomotor connectivity increased in bipolar disorder.
P4.relation_zh: 这是跨诊断感觉运动回路的相关研究，但测量的是丘脑—皮层而非 SomMot 网络内部均值；升高结果不能被算作本假设的下降支持。
P4.relation_en: This study concerns sensorimotor circuitry across diagnoses, but measures thalamocortical connectivity rather than the within-SomMot mean. Its increases must not be counted as support for the proposed decrease.

P5.did_zh: 研究比较早期及慢性精神病患者与健康对照，发现前额叶—丘脑连接降低、躯体运动—丘脑连接升高，并考察连接与认知的关系。
P5.did_en: The study compared early-stage and chronic psychosis with controls, finding reduced prefrontal-thalamic and increased somatomotor-thalamic connectivity and examining associations with cognition.
P5.relation_zh: 提供精神病中感觉运动连接异常的背景与不同方向结果；不包含本例双相障碍与精神分裂症谱系的 SomMot 网络内均值检验。
P5.relation_en: It supplies sensorimotor-connectivity context and a different directional result in psychosis, not this case's within-SomMot mean test across bipolar disorder and the schizophrenia spectrum.

P1.did_zh: 研究随访 211 名从 MCI 进展至阿尔茨海默病痴呆的 ADNI 参与者，比较不同 APOE 基因型的认知及脑体积变化。ε4 携带者在进入痴呆阶段后，全脑、海马、内嗅皮层和颞中回萎缩较快，脑室扩大也较快。
P1.did_en: The study followed 211 ADNI participants who progressed from MCI to Alzheimer's dementia, comparing cognitive and volumetric trajectories by APOE genotype. After dementia onset, ε4 carriers showed faster whole-brain, hippocampal, entorhinal and middle temporal atrophy, along with faster ventricular expansion.
P1.relation_zh: 该研究将 ε4 与痴呆阶段更快的内嗅皮层萎缩联系起来。本案例把纵向变化线索转成基线剂量问题：ε4 拷贝数较多的人，入组时的内嗅皮层是否已经较小，并在另一批数据中检验。
P1.relation_en: The study links ε4 with faster entorhinal atrophy during dementia. This case asks a baseline dosage question: do people with more ε4 copies already have smaller entorhinal volumes at enrollment, and does the association recur in another dataset?

P2.did_zh: 在无症状 APOE ε4 携带者中，采用非空间导航策略者比采用空间策略者表现出更明显的海马、内嗅皮层及海马伞萎缩；使用空间策略者的灰质水平与非携带者相近。
P2.did_en: Among asymptomatic APOE ε4 carriers, non-spatial navigators showed greater hippocampal, entorhinal and fimbria atrophy than spatial navigators. Spatial navigators had grey-matter levels comparable to non-carriers.
P2.relation_zh: 直接涉及 APOE 与内嗅皮层结构，但重点是携带者内导航策略差异，并未证明 ε4 拷贝数与基线归一化体积呈线性关系。
P2.relation_en: It directly concerns APOE and entorhinal structure, but focuses on navigation differences within carriers rather than a linear association between ε4 copy number and normalized baseline volume.

P3.did_zh: 研究随访245名起初认知正常者，发现内侧颞叶 MRI 指标、APOE ε4 与认知储备对 MCI 症状出现时间主要呈独立、相加的预测关系。
P3.did_en: In 245 initially cognitively normal participants, medial-temporal MRI measures, APOE ε4 and cognitive reserve predicted MCI symptom onset largely independently and additively.
P3.relation_zh: 帮助区分遗传风险和内嗅皮层结构两类指标；二者共同预测病程不等于 ε4 剂量必然导致更小的内嗅皮层体积。
P3.relation_en: It distinguishes genetic risk from entorhinal structure: their joint prognostic value does not establish that greater ε4 dosage necessarily implies smaller entorhinal volume.

P4.did_zh: ADNI 研究以海马和内嗅皮层12个月萎缩率为表型，检验通路内 SNP 交互作用，并把 APOE ε4 携带状态等作为协变量。
P4.did_en: An ADNI study tested within-pathway SNP interactions against 12-month hippocampal and entorhinal atrophy, adjusting for APOE ε4 carrier status and other covariates.
P4.relation_zh: 提供影像遗传学测量与分析背景；APOE 在此为协变量，结局为萎缩率，不能视为 ε4 剂量—基线内嗅皮层体积的直接验证。ADNI 数据可能与本例重叠。
P4.relation_en: It provides imaging-genetics methodology. APOE is a covariate and the outcome is atrophy rate, not a direct test of ε4 dosage against baseline entorhinal volume. ADNI data may overlap this case.

P5.did_zh: 在178名 ADNI A+T+ MCI 参与者中，APOE ε4 携带者的双侧内嗅皮层更薄、双侧海马体积更小，并有更明显的部分认知损害。
P5.did_en: Among 178 ADNI A+T+ MCI participants, APOE ε4 carriers had thinner bilateral entorhinal cortices, smaller bilateral hippocampi and greater impairment in some cognitive domains.
P5.relation_zh: 直接关联 APOE 与内嗅皮层，但使用携带状态和皮层厚度，而本例使用剂量和归一化体积；A+T+ 筛选及 ADNI 队列重叠也限制迁移。
P5.relation_en: It links APOE to entorhinal structure, but uses carrier status and cortical thickness rather than dosage and normalized volume. A+T+ selection and possible ADNI cohort overlap limit transfer.

P1.did_zh: 研究分析 320,861 人的认知数据及 29,510 人的脑影像，考察 APOE、Klotho、年龄和性别。APOE ε4 纯合子表现出更明显的年龄相关认知下降，海马和杏仁核也较小。
P1.did_en: The study examined APOE, Klotho, age and sex using cognitive data from 320,861 people and imaging from 29,510. APOE ε4 homozygotes showed greater age-related cognitive decline and smaller hippocampi and amygdalae.
P1.relation_zh: 既有研究已观察到 ε4 纯合子海马较小，提供了基因型与脑结构的直接线索。本案例进一步按 0、1、2 个拷贝检验剂量关系，并在 ADNI 的两个数据批次中检查关联能否重现。
P1.relation_en: The observation of smaller hippocampi in ε4 homozygotes provides direct genotype–structure evidence. This case tests dosage across zero, one and two copies and examines whether the association recurs in two ADNI data phases.

P2.did_zh: 对认知正常的中老年人进行纵向 MRI 随访，发现 ε4 携带者起初海马体积较小，但其海马萎缩速度并未比 ε3 纯合子更快。
P2.did_en: Longitudinal MRI in cognitively normal middle-aged and older adults found smaller initial hippocampal volumes in ε4 carriers, but no faster hippocampal atrophy than in ε3 homozygotes.
P2.relation_zh: 与基线海马体积假设密切相关，同时提示基线大小和后续变化率应分开；携带状态比较仍不等于连续剂量效应。
P2.relation_en: It is closely related to baseline hippocampal volume and distinguishes initial size from subsequent change. A carrier comparison is still not a continuous dosage effect.

P3.did_zh: Lothian Birth Cohort 1936 的老年社区样本中，APOE 或 TOMM40 基因型与海马体积未呈显著关联，无论使用原始体积还是颅内容积/全脑组织体积校正。
P3.did_en: In older community participants from the Lothian Birth Cohort 1936, neither APOE nor TOMM40 genotype was significantly associated with hippocampal volume, whether raw or adjusted for intracranial or total brain-tissue volume.
P3.relation_zh: 这是与 APOE—海马体积假设直接相关的零结果，提示效应可能依赖人群和体积校正方式，不能只列同向结果。
P3.relation_en: This directly relevant null finding cautions that APOE–hippocampal associations may depend on population and volume adjustment; it is not supporting evidence for a decrease.

P4.did_zh: 多队列研究比较 APOE、淀粉样蛋白与基线海马体积；AD/MCI 中 ε4 携带者体积较小，ε4 与淀粉样蛋白阳性共同出现时更明显，但健康青少年未见 APOE 组间差异。
P4.did_en: A multi-cohort study related APOE and amyloid to baseline hippocampal volume. ε4 carriers with AD/MCI had smaller volumes, particularly with amyloid positivity, whereas healthy adolescents showed no APOE-group differences.
P4.relation_zh: 直接关联 APOE 与海马基线结构，但强调疾病和年龄背景；不能把跨等位基因组差异直接等同于本例0、1、2拷贝的剂量斜率。
P4.relation_en: It directly relates APOE to baseline hippocampal structure while emphasizing disease and age context. Differences across allele groups are not identical to this case's 0/1/2-copy dosage slope.

P5.did_zh: Lifebrain 纵向研究分析748名无痴呆者的海马体积和情景记忆，发现体积变化与记忆变化的关联在 ε4 携带者中更明显。
P5.did_en: A longitudinal Lifebrain study of 748 non-demented participants found stronger coupling between hippocampal-volume change and episodic-memory change in ε4 carriers.
P5.relation_zh: 提供 APOE 调节海马结构—认知关系的纵向背景，不直接检验剂量与基线海马体积的关系。
P5.relation_en: It provides longitudinal context for APOE modulation of hippocampal–cognitive relationships, not a direct test of dosage against baseline hippocampal volume.

P1.did_zh: 研究随访 211 名从 MCI 进展至阿尔茨海默病痴呆的 ADNI 参与者，比较不同 APOE 基因型的认知及脑体积变化。ε4 携带者在进入痴呆阶段后，全脑、海马、内嗅皮层和颞中回萎缩较快，脑室扩大也较快。
P1.did_en: The study followed 211 ADNI participants who progressed from MCI to Alzheimer's dementia, comparing cognitive and volumetric trajectories by APOE genotype. After dementia onset, ε4 carriers showed faster whole-brain, hippocampal, entorhinal and middle temporal atrophy, along with faster ventricular expansion.
P1.relation_zh: 颞中回萎缩更快的观察使关注点从海马扩展到外侧颞叶。本案例检验的不是萎缩速度，而是一次基线扫描中的体积与 ε4 剂量关系，考察同一遗传线索能否体现在这一结构指标中。
P1.relation_en: The faster middle temporal atrophy finding extends attention beyond the hippocampus to lateral temporal cortex. This case tests volume from a single baseline scan rather than atrophy rate, asking whether ε4 dosage relates to that structural measure.

P2.did_zh: 研究在 APOE4 背景下比较 AD 与对照的结构 MRI、灰质体积及结构网络，报告 AD 的右颞中回等区域灰质体积降低。
P2.did_en: The study examined structural MRI, grey-matter volume and structural networks in AD and controls in the context of APOE4, reporting reduced right middle-temporal and other regional grey-matter volumes in AD.
P2.relation_zh: 涉及同一颞中回结构和 APOE 研究背景，但摘要中的 AD—对照差异不能被解释成 ε4 剂量对归一化体积的独立效应。
P2.relation_en: It concerns the same middle-temporal structure and APOE context, but the abstract's AD–control contrast cannot be interpreted as an independent ε4-dosage effect on normalized volume.

P3.did_zh: 128名认知正常中年人的研究考察性别、APOE 与皮层厚度。女性的左颞中皮层较厚，APOE 相关差异主要报告于部分额叶及扣带区域，并受性别影响。
P3.did_en: In 128 cognitively unimpaired middle-aged adults, sex and APOE were examined against cortical thickness. Women had thicker left middle-temporal cortex; reported APOE-related differences mainly involved frontal and cingulate regions and varied by sex.
P3.relation_zh: 作为性别与测量选择的相关背景；颞中皮层的性别差异不是 APOE 效应，厚度也不等于本例体积，不据此声称支持剂量假设。
P3.relation_en: This is context for sex and measurement choice. A middle-temporal sex difference is not an APOE effect, and thickness is not this case's volume measure; it does not establish the dosage hypothesis.

P4.did_zh: 65名遗忘型 MCI 参与者的基线 VBM 研究发现，APOE ε4 携带者在海马及颞上、颞中回等区域有更多灰质萎缩，并考察 MAPT 的共同作用。
P4.did_en: Baseline VBM in 65 participants with amnestic MCI found greater grey-matter atrophy in APOE ε4 carriers in hippocampal, superior-temporal and middle-temporal regions, and examined joint effects with MAPT.
P4.relation_zh: 直接涉及 APOE 和颞中回灰质结构，但携带状态、VBM 萎缩模式与本例连续剂量—归一化体积并非同一统计量。
P4.relation_en: It directly concerns APOE and middle-temporal grey matter, but carrier status and VBM atrophy patterns are not identical to continuous dosage against normalized regional volume.

P5.did_zh: 83名 MCI 参与者按 ε4 的0、1、2拷贝分组进行 VBM 比较；纯合子内侧颞叶灰质密度降低，右颞上及颞中回的改变则报告于白质。
P5.did_en: VBM compared 83 participants with MCI across 0, 1 and 2 ε4 copies. Homozygotes showed reduced medial-temporal grey-matter density; right superior- and middle-temporal changes were reported in white matter.
P5.relation_zh: 提供剂量分组和颞叶形态背景，但颞中回结果属于白质，不能直接当作本例颞中回皮层体积降低的证据。
P5.relation_en: It provides dosage-group and temporal-morphology context, but the middle-temporal result concerns white matter, not direct evidence for lower middle-temporal cortical volume in this case.

P1.did_zh: 研究随访 60 名 MCI 参与者，平均随访 34 个月，13 人进展至痴呆，其中 9 人为阿尔茨海默病。基线右侧海马及内嗅皮层体积有助于预测痴呆进展，内嗅皮层体积还与阿尔茨海默病转归相关。
P1.did_en: Sixty participants with MCI were followed for an average of 34 months; 13 developed dementia, including nine with Alzheimer's disease. Baseline right hippocampal and entorhinal volumes predicted dementia progression, and entorhinal volume also predicted conversion to Alzheimer's disease.
P1.relation_zh: 该研究已经提示，基线内嗅皮层体积可提供 MCI 预后信息。本案例在 ADNI 的两个批次中重新检验这种关系，并比较 2、3、5 年窗口，观察关联在不同随访长度下是否一致。
P1.relation_en: The study establishes a rationale for baseline entorhinal volume as a prognostic measure. This case re-examines the relationship in two ADNI phases and compares two-, three- and five-year windows to assess consistency over follow-up.

P2.did_zh: 139名 MCI 患者及63名对照平均随访5年。较小的基线海马和内嗅皮层体积均预测向 AD 转化，但在年龄与认知指标之外增加的预测价值较小。
P2.did_en: Over approximately five years, 139 patients with MCI and 63 controls were followed. Smaller baseline hippocampal and entorhinal volumes predicted AD conversion, with modest added value beyond age and cognition.
P2.relation_zh: 与内嗅皮层基线体积和进展风险直接相关；随访范围、临床样本及协变量组合与本例不完全相同，也未证明队列独立性。
P2.relation_en: It directly concerns baseline entorhinal volume and progression risk, but follow-up, clinical sampling and covariates differ from this case; cohort independence is not established.

P3.did_zh: 61名遗忘型 MCI 患者的研究比较内嗅皮层萎缩视觉评分 ERICA 与内侧颞叶萎缩评分预测 AD 转化的表现；ERICA 特异度较高但敏感度较低。
P3.did_en: In 61 patients with amnestic MCI, visual ERICA and medial-temporal atrophy scores were compared for predicting AD conversion. ERICA had higher specificity but lower sensitivity.
P3.relation_zh: 相关于内嗅皮层结构和 MCI 预后，但采用视觉萎缩量表而非归一化连续体积；小样本结果不等于本例风险模型已验证。
P3.relation_en: It relates entorhinal structure to MCI prognosis, but uses a visual atrophy scale rather than normalized continuous volume. This small-sample result does not validate the present risk model.

P4.did_zh: 27名 MCI 患者接受基线高分辨率 MRI 并随访36个月，10人转化为 AD；基线内嗅皮层和海马体积均有预测价值，其中右内嗅皮层区分表现较好。
P4.did_en: Twenty-seven patients with MCI underwent baseline high-resolution MRI and 36-month follow-up; ten converted to AD. Entorhinal and hippocampal volumes predicted conversion, with right entorhinal volume performing best.
P4.relation_zh: 与本例基线内嗅皮层体积及进展问题直接相关，但样本小、侧化定义与建模方式不同，不能把原研究准确率迁移成本例表现。
P4.relation_en: It directly addresses baseline entorhinal volume and progression, but its small sample, lateralization and model differ. Its reported accuracy cannot be transferred to this case.

P5.did_zh: MCI 纵向研究用表面形态学定位进展者的海马与内嗅皮层局部萎缩，提示海马 CA1/下托及双侧内嗅皮层前下极的形变可预测转化。
P5.did_en: A longitudinal MCI study used surface morphometry to localize atrophy associated with conversion, identifying hippocampal CA1/subiculum and bilateral anterior-inferior entorhinal deformation.
P5.relation_zh: 说明同一脑区内部位置可能影响预后价值；局部表面形变不是本例整个内嗅皮层平均体积，相关论文也不自动代表独立队列。
P5.relation_en: It shows that location within the region may affect prognostic value. Local surface deformation is not whole-region entorhinal volume, and separate papers do not automatically imply independent cohorts.

P1.did_zh: 研究对 947 名 ADNI MCI 参与者的 192 项 MRI 结构指标进行纵向分析，随访中 314 人进展至阿尔茨海默病。分析筛出包括右颞中回、海马、脑室及全脑体积在内的结构特征，其变化轨迹与进展风险相关。
P1.did_en: The study analyzed 192 longitudinal MRI structural measures in 947 ADNI participants with MCI, of whom 314 progressed to Alzheimer's disease. Selected features included right middle temporal, hippocampal, ventricular and whole-brain measures whose trajectories related to progression risk.
P1.relation_zh: 这项研究把右颞中回的纵向萎缩轨迹与进展风险联系起来。本案例转而检验一次基线 MRI 中的颞中回体积是否已经包含预后信息，并在另一 ADNI 批次及不同随访窗口中比较。
P1.relation_en: The study links longitudinal right middle temporal atrophy to progression risk. This case asks whether volume from one baseline MRI already contains prognostic information and compares another ADNI phase and different follow-up windows.

P2.did_zh: ADNI-1 研究联合纵向指标和生存资料预测 MCI 向 AD 转化；颞中回与海马体积属于较强影像预测指标，但认知指标通常更强。
P2.did_en: An ADNI-1 study jointly modelled longitudinal measures and survival to predict MCI-to-AD conversion. Middle-temporal and hippocampal volumes were strong imaging predictors, although cognitive measures were generally stronger.
P2.relation_zh: 直接涉及颞中回和进展时间，但使用纵向变化信息，而本例检验基线体积；同属 ADNI，不能自动视为独立验证。
P2.relation_en: It directly concerns middle-temporal structure and time to progression, but incorporates longitudinal change rather than baseline volume alone. Shared ADNI provenance prevents assuming independent validation.

P3.did_zh: ADNI 研究构建 MCI 向 AD 转化的积分工具，组合日常功能、颞中皮层变薄、海马体积及认知测验来预测3年转化。
P3.did_en: An ADNI study developed a point score for MCI-to-AD conversion combining daily function, middle-temporal cortical thinning, hippocampal volume and cognitive tests to predict three-year conversion.
P3.relation_zh: 提供颞中回结构的预后背景，但厚度不是体积，组合积分也不是单一脑区的风险效应；ADNI 样本可能重叠。
P3.relation_en: It provides prognostic context for middle-temporal structure, but thickness is not volume and a composite score is not a single-region risk effect. ADNI samples may overlap.

P4.did_zh: 18名遗忘型 MCI 患者随访18个月，7人转化为 AD；转化者在海马、颞下/颞中回等区域表现出更快的灰质丢失。
P4.did_en: Eighteen patients with amnestic MCI were followed for 18 months; seven converted to AD. Converters showed faster grey-matter loss in hippocampal, inferior-/middle-temporal and other regions.
P4.relation_zh: 与颞中回和临床进展相关，但主要证据是随访萎缩速度，不是较低基线体积的独立风险比。
P4.relation_en: It relates middle-temporal structure to progression, but the relevant finding is longitudinal atrophy, not an independent hazard ratio for lower baseline volume.

P5.did_zh: ADNI 研究比较两年内116名转化者与204名未转化者，多类指标联合分析中，基线延迟记忆和颞中叶皮层厚度能预测转化；认知指标通常比多数生物标志物更稳健。
P5.did_en: An ADNI study compared 116 converters and 204 non-converters over two years. Baseline delayed memory and middle-temporal cortical thickness predicted conversion in combined models; cognition was generally more robust than most biomarkers.
P5.relation_zh: 涉及同一颞中结构和两年预后，但测量为厚度而非体积，也不能将重复使用 ADNI 视为独立队列复现。
P5.relation_en: It concerns the same middle-temporal structure and two-year prognosis, but measures thickness rather than volume. Reuse of ADNI is not independent cohort replication.

P1.did_zh: 研究随访 139 名 ADNI MCI 参与者，将全脑、海马、脑室体积与遗传、脑脊液及认知指标联合用于预测进展。模型在不同随访时间的预测表现有所变化，认知指标在较晚随访阶段仍有预测价值。
P1.did_en: The study followed 139 ADNI participants with MCI and combined whole-brain, hippocampal and ventricular volumes with genetic, CSF and cognitive measures to predict progression. Predictive performance varied with follow-up duration, while cognitive measures remained informative later in follow-up.
P1.relation_zh: 既有模型已纳入全脑体积，但它与其他脑区、认知和生物标志物共同参与预测。本案例单独考察这一整体结构指标与进展时间的关联，并将观察窗口延伸到 5 年。
P1.relation_en: The earlier model included whole-brain volume together with regional, cognitive and biological measures. This case examines the global structural measure's association with time to progression and extends the observation window to five years.

P2.did_zh: 123名 MCI 患者随访12个月，研究认知与脑储备对转化或恢复的关系；恢复者的基线海马/全脑体积比更高，部分区域灰质丢失组间无显著差异。
P2.did_en: In 123 patients with MCI followed for 12 months, cognitive and brain reserve were studied against conversion or reversion. Reverters had a higher baseline hippocampal/whole-brain volume ratio, while some regional grey-matter-loss comparisons were non-significant.
P2.relation_zh: 提供脑储备与进展的相关背景，但海马/全脑比值不能解释为全脑体积本身的保护效应，且随访窗口更短。
P2.relation_en: It provides brain-reserve and progression context, but a hippocampal/whole-brain ratio cannot be interpreted as a protective effect of whole-brain volume itself; follow-up is also shorter.

P3.did_zh: 156名主观认知下降或 MCI 患者的自动 MRI 体积研究发现，全脑体积未关联诊断转化，但与 CDR-SB 年变化有关；诊断转化和连续认知恶化呈不同结果。
P3.did_en: Automated MRI volumetry in 156 patients with subjective decline or MCI found that whole-brain volume was not associated with diagnostic conversion, but was associated with annual CDR-SB change. Diagnostic conversion and continuous decline yielded different results.
P3.relation_zh: 这是全脑体积—转化假设的重要零结果及结局区分，不能因为与连续评分相关就写成支持痴呆转化风险。
P3.relation_en: This is an important null result and endpoint distinction for the whole-brain-volume conversion hypothesis. An association with continuous decline must not be recast as support for dementia conversion.

P4.did_zh: 前瞻性队列以脑实质占颅腔比例衡量全脑结构；该比例较低可预测基线 MCI 者向痴呆转化，但不预测正常认知者向 MCI 进展。
P4.did_en: A prospective cohort measured global structure as brain parenchymal fraction. Lower fraction predicted dementia conversion in baseline MCI, but not progression from normal cognition to MCI.
P4.relation_zh: 与归一化全脑体积和 MCI 进展密切相关，同时提示疾病阶段重要；脑实质比例、成像序列与本例 WholeBrain_icv 的实现仍需区分。
P4.relation_en: It is closely related to normalized whole-brain volume and MCI progression and emphasizes disease stage. Brain parenchymal fraction and its imaging implementation still differ from this case's WholeBrain_icv.

P5.did_zh: 研究比较海马与全脑 MRI 指标预测 AD 进展的价值；全脑萎缩率在合并无痴呆样本中有预测作用，但在 MCI 子组中仅海马基线体积和萎缩率预测进展。
P5.did_en: A study compared hippocampal and whole-brain MRI predictors of AD progression. Whole-brain atrophy rate predicted progression in the pooled non-demented sample, but only hippocampal baseline volume and atrophy rate predicted progression within MCI.
P5.relation_zh: 提供全脑与局部指标的直接比较及边界结果；全脑萎缩率不等于基线体积，合并样本的关联不能替代 MCI 子组结论。
P5.relation_en: It directly compares global and regional measures and supplies a limiting result. Whole-brain atrophy rate is not baseline volume, and pooled-sample associations cannot replace MCI-specific conclusions.

packet-01.zh: 把右侧 ROI312 分区与显著/腹侧注意（SalVentAttn）网络所有分区之间的功能连接取平均，作为本假设的测量指标。它只是这一个分区到该网络的平均连接，不代表整个脑区或整个网络。
packet-01.en: The measure averages functional connectivity between the right ROI312 parcel and every parcel of the SalVentAttn network. It is only that parcel-to-network average, not an entire anatomical region.

packet-02.zh: 把左侧 ROI108 分区与躯体运动（SomMot）网络所有分区之间的功能连接取平均，作为本假设的测量指标。它只是这一个分区到该网络的平均连接，不代表整个脑区或整个网络。
packet-02.en: The measure averages functional connectivity between the left ROI108 parcel and every parcel of the SomMot network. It is only that parcel-to-network average, not an entire anatomical region.

packet-03.zh: 把右侧 ROI254 分区与显著/腹侧注意（SalVentAttn）网络所有分区之间的功能连接取平均，作为本假设的测量指标。它只是这一个分区到该网络的平均连接，不代表整个脑区或整个网络。
packet-03.en: The measure averages functional connectivity between the right ROI254 parcel and every parcel of the SalVentAttn network. It is only that parcel-to-network average, not an entire anatomical region.

packet-05.zh: 把躯体运动（SomMot）网络内部各分区之间的功能连接取平均（共 2,926 条），作为本假设的测量指标；它反映该网络内部的总体连接强度，不针对单个分区。
packet-05.en: The measure averages every parcel-to-parcel functional connection within the SomMot network (2,926 connections in total); it reflects overall within-network connectivity rather than any single parcel.
